timing: After corrected mitotic model results and plate coverage review; before complete interphase preparation/fitting or effect analysis.

cross_arm_count_baseline.status: Already required by the original v33 plan; still pending both complete exports
cross_arm_count_baseline.definition: Observed mitotic cells / (observed mitotic + observed interphase cells), matched by exact guide sequence and consistent gene label.
cross_arm_count_baseline.missing_rule: Zero observed cells in one arm is allowed only after complete export coverage is verified and the guide is present in the other arm. Missing or conflicting attribution is a failure, not zero.
cross_arm_count_baseline.retrieval: Within each arm's existing eligible test cohort, absolute-distance retrieval with the same distinct-guide own-reference policy and average exact-tie ranks.
cross_arm_count_baseline.scope: Selected fixed-cell class fraction, not measured viability, mitotic duration, all-enrolled survival or probability of rescue.

matched_sampling_diagnostic.status: Exploratory addition after mitotic results; not part of the originally registered eight within-arm baselines
matched_sampling_diagnostic.reason: The encoder uses at most 128 sampled cells per guide while the practical full-profile baseline uses all cells. Failure against that baseline cannot isolate representation quality from sampling information.
matched_sampling_diagnostic.definition: Source-clipped feature means from the exact deterministic cells already selected for neural fitting. Reuse each fitted model's training-gene-only feature retention, center and scale, and the original cosine retrieval.
matched_sampling_diagnostic.no_selection: No new sampling, guide thresholds, architecture, checkpoints, seeds, hyperparameters or drug ranking. Evaluate all eligible test genes and ten queries in both arms.
matched_sampling_diagnostic.interpretation: Report alongside the original full-data baseline. It cannot retroactively rescue the failed primary mitotic practical-gain gate. A gain over a sampled baseline alone does not establish a gain over the strongest full-data baseline.

unchanged: No drug, phase, exposure, wet-lab or clinical promotion
